mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary policy that compresses discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market tightness indicated by unemployment rate falling below 4.5% signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous acceleration in industrial production and deceleration in unemployment indicates a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (INDPRO rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime, a decline in housing starts signals a weakening housing market and economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.0% AND HOUST declines by > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: In periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% and HOUST declines by > 0.5%, SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment over the past 3 months signals strong labor market conditions and rising consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases over the past 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production below 100 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in consumer price inflation signals an accommodative monetary policy amid rising inflation, which typically leads to positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL rise) fails to produce positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high consumer spending regime, a decline in housing starts signals a weakening in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 500000 AND HOUST declines by > 0.5% in the past month
failure_condition: In periods when RSAFS > 500000 and HOUST declines by > 0.5%, SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.
